rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE providers; providers/programs approved by ASWB (ACE) or a similar designated body; NASW-approved programs; academic coursework (1 semester credit = 15 h). Providers need not be preapproved if the activity meets statutory criteria
rules.notes: LICSW: 12 hours in clinical content areas (no topic code). Max half via independent learning. Prorated if the renewal term is not 24 months. Keep documentation 1 year after license expiration.
rules.rule_quote: (a) A licensee must complete 40 hours of continuing education for each two-year renewal term.
